arithmetic.canonical_nan_output: Every floating NaN result is the destination format canonical quiet NaN.
arithmetic.exception_model: IEEE-754 invalid, divide-by-zero, overflow, underflow, and inexact conditions are reported through the operation-defined architectural status; host traps are not observable.
arithmetic.fused_operations: A fused operation rounds once after the exact multiply-add expression.
arithmetic.signed_zero: IEEE signed zero is preserved; exact cancellation follows the selected rounding mode and min/max use -0 for minimum and +0 for maximum.
arithmetic.subnormals: supported; flush-to-zero and denormals-are-zero are non-conforming

canonicalize.0: Do not pre-canonicalize source NaN payloads; every produced NaN is still the canonical destination qNaN.
canonicalize.1: Replace every NaN source by its source-format canonical qNaN before the operation; signed zero is unchanged.

rounding_modes.0: NONE: use the operation-defined default; the hardware numeric default is RNE
rounding_modes.5: RNA: nearest, ties away from zero
rounding_modes.6: RTO: round to odd when inexact
rounding_modes.7: RHB: nearest, halfway toward positive infinity

saturation.disabled: Integer arithmetic wraps to destination width; floating overflow follows IEEE infinity; invalid float-to-integer conversion returns the destination indefinite value.
saturation.enabled: Integer arithmetic and conversion clamp to destination minimum/maximum; NaN converts to zero; floating overflow clamps to the destination maximum finite value.

comparisons.signed_zero: +0 and -0 compare equal and neither is less than the other

data_types.format: e8m10 in a 32-bit carrier; discarded fraction bits are zero
data_types.name: TF32

data_types.format: e8m11 in a 32-bit carrier; discarded fraction bits are zero
data_types.name: HF32

data_types.format: e3m2 in the low six bits
data_types.name: E3M2

data_types.format: e2m3 in the low six bits
data_types.name: E2M3

data_types.format: two e2m1 lanes; lane 0 is bits 3:0 and lane 1 is bits 7:4
data_types.name: E2M1X2

data_types.format: two e1m2 lanes; lane 0 is bits 3:0 and lane 1 is bits 7:4
data_types.name: E1M2X2

data_types.format: unsigned e8m0 power-of-two scale; 0xFF is NaN
data_types.name: E8M0

data_types.format: two e1m2 lanes with operation-defined MX scaling; lane 0 is bits 3:0 and lane 1 is bits 7:4
data_types.name: HiF4X2

claim_requires: the exact profile ID and release content hash
all generated hardware numeric boundary vectors
independent downstream byte and effect parity

matrix.accumulator_initialization: Ordinary, BIAS, and MX variants initialize ACC; .ACC variants begin with the existing ACC value.
matrix.accumulator_type: FP64 inputs accumulate in FP64; other floating inputs accumulate in FP32; signed integers accumulate in S64; unsigned integers accumulate in U64.
matrix.dot_order: Products are accumulated in increasing K index order with one fused multiply-add rounding to the declared ACC type per term.
matrix.mx_scale: E8M0 scale is an exact power of two applied before multiplication; 0xFF produces canonical qNaN.
matrix.publication: ACCCVT rounds once to the destination type and releases ACC only after successful Tile publication.

reductions.evaluation_order: increasing logical row-major index; no reassociation
reductions.max_min_nan: ignore a NaN when a numeric operand exists; all-NaN input returns canonical qNaN
reductions.rounding: round to the declared accumulator type after each step

reference_model_relation.rule: pto-v0 output values are not hardware numeric conformance evidence

sort.nan_order: after all numeric values and stable by original index in both directions
sort.output: value paired with U32 original index
sort.signed_zero_order: +0 and -0 compare equal; original index controls their stable order
